# Place Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:PlaceType`](gmeow-PlaceType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PlaceType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The kind of a geographic place (country, region, city, building, room, …). Modelled as a value, not a [`Place`](gmeow-Place.md) subclass: the set of kinds is open-ended (GeoNames lists ~600 feature codes) and they share all of [`Place`](gmeow-Place.md)'s structure, so a new kind is a new individual, not a new class.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:PlaceType`](gmeow-PlaceType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
